hook_text: Is 750 millilitres more than 1 litre? 750 is a much bigger number than 1. Think again.
clip_script: Ginger beer day in Upington. The recipe needs 2 tablespoons of ginger. A tablespoon is 15 ml, so 30 ml. Now the water: 4 measuring cups of 250 ml fill a 1 litre jug, because 1 litre is 1 000 ml. The jug has numbers every 200 ml and a small mark in between, so each mark is 100 ml. Bend down, eyes level with the water: 700 ml. Now the question. 750 ml or 1 litre? Change the litre to millilitres: 1 000 ml. So the litre wins, by 250 ml, one whole cup. Same unit first, then compare.
visual_style: Whiteboard measuring jug filling cup by cup with marks lighting up; a 750 ml jug beside a 1 litre bottle with 1 000 ml written underneath.
pacing: The trick question, spoons and cups, reading the jug, then the reveal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find the capacity printed on five containers in your kitchen.
